A kernel parameter, set now and kept across reboots in /etc/sysctl.d.

```hcl
step "example" {
  sysctl {
    name = "..."
    value = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Key, such as net.ipv4.ip_forward. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "forget" (default) leaves the setting, "delete" removes its file; the running value stays until reboot. |
| `value` | string | Yes | Value. Separate several with spaces. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_sysctl.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the file and the running kernel both have the value. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_sysctl` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
